defects.summary: AfterRoundAsync only treats an undecided (Spent == null) agy refusal as a candidate when RateLimit.Hopeless(reason) is true, so an older-shape AGY_ERROR whose message lacks a spent word never asks the /quota gauge, although D5 says the gauge decides every undecided agy case.
The public `Now` property is never used anywhere in the change; PanelService reads its own `_clock` instead.
The doc comment cites `research/PLAN_a_spent_quota_cools_the_model_down.md`, but the plan lives under `todo/`, which is where every other new file points.
A file with a version other than 1 is read as empty even under the lock, so the next park silently replaces a file from a newer writer instead of refusing the write.
S37's 'one notice handed to the notice writer' is checked through the onRefused callback only; nothing tests the PanelService wiring to QuotaNotices/NoticeWriter (recorded as deviation 2).

summary: A complete, faithful implementation: all 43 scenarios exist and pass, build and both suites are green, and the structured verdict, agy error and /quota readers, the D3 table, the locked fail-open cooldown file, per-key aggregation, roster exclusion, wire member and card all follow D1–D12, with sensible extra guards (DeepSeek and custom codex keys left empty, a file unreadable under the lock refuses the write, a stated reset already past parks nothing). The plan's §12 records the deviations honestly and they hold up when checked (the extra `spent` parameter, S25's clock because CooldownParser keeps a past July date as-is, S34's undecided rows); what remains are minor gaps: an undecided agy edge case, a dead member and a wrong doc path.
